title: local-release qualify refuses a production package unless local-harvest audit passes on the exact candidate
goal: Mandate 74 section 5 on the installed-production path: run local-harvest audit in-process on the exact integrated candidate worktree, over its whole history, before any build; fail closed; record the result as harvest-audit= in manifest-bound gates.txt. Complements release-qualify (tag records) without adding a receipt gate id, so previously qualified packages stay valid for rollback.
validation: harvest_audit_failure_stops_qualification_before_any_build and real_qualification_promotion_rollback_and_failure_preserve_verified_release pass with the 9 embedded harvest tests (10 passed, 0 failed); the full local-release suite was not run.
